	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(SpecialSongManager), "InitHideBmsInfoDic")]
	internal static class HideBmsInfoDicPatch
	{
		private static readonly Logger Logger = new Logger("HideBmsInfoDicPatch");

		internal static bool HasUpdate { get; set; } = true;

		private static void Postfix(SpecialSongManager __instance)
		{
			//IL_009b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00a2: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_019a: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01a4: Expected O, but got Unknown
			//IL_01a5: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_01ac: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!HasUpdate)
			{
				return;
			}
			foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Album> item in AlbumManager.LoadedAlbums.Where((KeyValuePair<string, Album> kv) => kv.Value.HasDifficulty(4) || kv.Value.HasDifficulty(5)))
			{
				item.Deconstruct(out var key, out var value);
				string text = key;
				Album album = value;
				if (album.HasDifficulty(5))
				{
					Il2CppStringArray val = new Il2CppStringArray((long)(((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid).Length + 1));
					for (int num = 0; num < ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid).Length; num++)
					{
						((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val)[num] = ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid)[num];
					}
					((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val)[((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val).Length - 1] = album.Uid;
					DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid = val;
				}
				if (LoadedHiddens.Contains(album.Uid))
				{
					string albumUid = album.Uid;
					__instance.m_HideBmsInfos.Add(albumUid, new HideBmsInfo(albumUid, (!(album.Info.HideBmsDifficulty == "0")) ? album.Info.HideBmsDifficulty.ParseAsInt() : (album.HasDifficulty(3) ? 3 : 2), 4, text + "_map4", Func<bool>.op_Implicit((Func<bool>)(() => __instance.IsInvokeHideBms(albumUid)))));
					HideMusicInfo val2 = new HideMusicInfo();
					val2.musicUid = albumUid;
					HideMusicInfo val3 = val2;
					string hideBmsMode = album.Info.HideBmsMode;
					if (1 == 0)
					{
					}
					int invokeType = hideBmsMode switch
					{
						"CLICK" => 3, 
						"PRESS" => 1, 
						"TOGGLE" => 2, 
						_ => 0, 
					};
					if (1 == 0)
					{
					}
					val3.invokeType = invokeType;
					HideMusicInfo val4 = val2;
					__instance.m_ConfigHideMusic.m_HideMusicObjectMapping[albumUid] = val4;
				}
			}
			HasUpdate = false;
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(SpecialSongManager), "InvokeHideBms")]
	internal static class InvokeHideBmsPatch
	{
		private static readonly Logger Logger = new Logger("InvokeHideBmsPatch");

		private static bool Prefix(MusicInfo musicInfo, SpecialSongManager __instance)
		{
			if (!musicInfo.uid.StartsWith($"{999}-") || !LoadedHiddens.Contains(musicInfo.uid))
			{
				return true;
			}
			HideBmsInfo val = __instance.m_HideBmsInfos[musicInfo.uid];
			__instance.m_IsInvokeHideDic[val.uid] = true;
			if (!val.extraCondition.Invoke())
			{
				return false;
			}
			Album value = AlbumManager.LoadedAlbums.FirstOrDefault((KeyValuePair<string, Album> kv) => kv.Value.Index == musicInfo.musicIndex).Value;
			ActivateHidden(val);
			if (value.Info.HideBmsMessage != null)
			{
				PnlTipsManager instance = PnlTipsManager.instance;
				AbstractMessageBox messageBox = instance.GetMessageBox("PnlSpecialsBmsAsk");
				messageBox.Show("TIPS", value.Info.HideBmsMessage);
			}
			Action onTriggerHideBmsEvent = SpecialSongManager.onTriggerHideBmsEvent;
			if (onTriggerHideBmsEvent != null)
			{
				onTriggerHideBmsEvent.Invoke();
			}
			if (value.Info.HideBmsMode == "PRESS")
			{
				Singleton<EventManager>.instance.Invoke("UI/OnSpecialsMusic", (Il2CppReferenceArray<Object>)null);
			}
			return false;
		}

		private static void ActivateHidden(HideBmsInfo hideBms)
		{
			if (hideBms == null)
			{
				return;
			}
			MusicInfo musicInfoFromAll = GlobalDataBase.dbMusicTag.GetMusicInfoFromAll(hideBms.uid);
			if (hideBms.triggerDiff != 0)
			{
				int num = hideBms.triggerDiff;
				if (num == -1)
				{
					num = 2;
					((BaseDataObject)musicInfoFromAll).AddMaskValue("difficulty1", Object.op_Implicit("0"));
					((BaseDataObject)musicInfoFromAll).AddMaskValue("difficulty3", Object.op_Implicit("0"));
				}
				string text = "difficulty" + num;
				string text2 = "levelDesigner" + num;
				string text3 = "?";
				string text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
				switch (hideBms.m_HideDiff)
				{
				case 1:
					text3 = musicInfoFromAll.difficulty1;
					text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner1 ?? musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
					break;
				case 2:
					text3 = musicInfoFromAll.difficulty2;
					text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner2 ?? musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
					break;
				case 3:
					text3 = musicInfoFromAll.difficulty3;
					text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner3 ?? musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
					break;
				case 4:
					text3 = musicInfoFromAll.difficulty4;
					text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner4 ?? musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
					break;
				case 5:
					text3 = musicInfoFromAll.difficulty5;
					text4 = musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner5 ?? musicInfoFromAll.levelDesigner;
					break;
				}
				((BaseDataObject)musicInfoFromAll).AddMaskValue(text, Object.op_Implicit(text3));
				((BaseDataObject)musicInfoFromAll).AddMaskValue(text2, Object.op_Implicit(text4));
				musicInfoFromAll.SetDifficulty(num, hideBms.m_HideDiff);
			}
		}
	}

	[HarmonyPatch(typeof(MusicTagManager), "InitDefaultInfo")]
	internal class MusicTagPatch
	{
		private const int HiddenId = 32776;

		private static readonly Logger Logger = new Logger("MusicTagPatch");

		internal static bool HasUpdate { get; set; } = true;

		private static void Postfix()
		{
			//IL_00a4: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
			//IL_00aa: Expected O, but got Unknown
			if (!HasUpdate)
			{
				return;
			}
			List<string> val = new List<string>();
			foreach (var (_, album2) in AlbumManager.LoadedAlbums)
			{
				if (album2.HasDifficulty(DifficultyDefine.hide) && LoadedHiddens.Add(album2.Uid))
				{
					val.Add(album2.Uid);
				}
			}
			Il2CppStringArray val2 = new Il2CppStringArray((long)(((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal).Length + val.Count));
			for (int i = 0; i < ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal).Length; i++)
			{
				((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val2)[i] = ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal)[i];
			}
			for (int j = 0; j < val.Count; j++)
			{
				((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val2)[j + ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal).Length] = val[j];
			}
			DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal = val2;
			AlbumTagInfo albumTagInfo = GlobalDataBase.dbMusicTag.GetAlbumTagInfo(32776);
			albumTagInfo.AddTagUids(val);
			HasUpdate = false;
		}
	}

	internal static HashSet<string> LoadedHiddens = new HashSet<string>();

	private static readonly Logger Logger = new Logger("HiddenSupportPatch");

	internal static void UpdateHiddenCharts()
	{
		HideBmsInfoDicPatch.HasUpdate = true;
		MusicTagPatch.HasUpdate = true;
	}

	internal static void RegisterHiddenChartsDirectly()
	{
		//IL_036d: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0374: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_00d2: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_00d9: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_0210: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_021a: Expected O, but got Unknown
		//IL_021b: Unknown result type (might be due to invalid IL or missing references)
		//IL_0222: Expected O, but got Unknown
		SpecialSongManager specialSongMgr = Singleton<SpecialSongManager>.instance;
		if (specialSongMgr == null)
		{
			return;
		}
		List<string> val = new List<string>();
		foreach (KeyValuePair<string, Album> loadedAlbum in AlbumManager.LoadedAlbums)
		{
			loadedAlbum.Deconstruct(out var key, out var value);
			string text = key;
			Album album = value;
			if (!album.HasDifficulty(4) && !album.HasDifficulty(5))
			{
				continue;
			}
			string albumUid = album.Uid;
			if (album.HasDifficulty(5) && !((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid).Contains(albumUid))
			{
				Il2CppStringArray s_BarrageModeSongUid = DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid;
				Il2CppStringArray val2 = new Il2CppStringArray((long)(((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_BarrageModeSongUid).Length + 1));
				for (int i = 0; i < ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_BarrageModeSongUid).Length; i++)
				{
					((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val2)[i] = ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_BarrageModeSongUid)[i];
				}
				((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val2)[((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val2).Length - 1] = albumUid;
				DBMusicTagDefine.s_BarrageModeSongUid = val2;
			}
			if (!album.HasDifficulty(4) || !LoadedHiddens.Add(albumUid))
			{
				continue;
			}
			val.Add(albumUid);
			if (!specialSongMgr.m_HideBmsInfos.ContainsKey(albumUid))
			{
				int num = ((!(album.Info.HideBmsDifficulty == "0")) ? album.Info.HideBmsDifficulty.ParseAsInt() : (album.HasDifficulty(3) ? 3 : 2));
				specialSongMgr.m_HideBmsInfos.Add(albumUid, new HideBmsInfo(albumUid, num, 4, text + "_map4", Func<bool>.op_Implicit((Func<bool>)(() => specialSongMgr.IsInvokeHideBms(albumUid)))));
				HideMusicInfo val3 = new HideMusicInfo();
				val3.musicUid = albumUid;
				HideMusicInfo val4 = val3;
				string hideBmsMode = album.Info.HideBmsMode;
				if (1 == 0)
				{
				}
				int invokeType = hideBmsMode switch
				{
					"CLICK" => 3, 
					"PRESS" => 1, 
					"TOGGLE" => 2, 
					_ => 0, 
				};
				if (1 == 0)
				{
				}
				val4.invokeType = invokeType;
				HideMusicInfo val5 = val3;
				specialSongMgr.m_ConfigHideMusic.m_HideMusicObjectMapping[albumUid] = val5;
				Logger.Msg($"Registered hidden for {albumUid} (trigger={album.Info.HideBmsMode})", verbose: false);
			}
		}
		if (val.Count > 0)
		{
			Il2CppStringArray s_HiddenLocal = DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal;
			Il2CppStringArray val6 = new Il2CppStringArray((long)(((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_HiddenLocal).Length + val.Count));
			for (int num2 = 0; num2 < ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_HiddenLocal).Length; num2++)
			{
				((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val6)[num2] = ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_HiddenLocal)[num2];
			}
			for (int num3 = 0; num3 < val.Count; num3++)
			{
				((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)val6)[num3 + ((Il2CppArrayBase<string>)(object)s_HiddenLocal).Length] = val[num3];
			}
			DBMusicTagDefine.s_HiddenLocal = val6;
			AlbumTagInfo albumTagInfo = GlobalDataBase.dbMusicTag.GetAlbumTagInfo(32776);
			if (albumTagInfo != null)
			{
				albumTagInfo.AddTagUids(val);
			}
		}
	}
